    app.specific_cycle(3, p_31=276, t_31=3, p_32=3.7, t_32=20, r_c3=0, cw31=[0, 255], cw32=[1365, 1440])


if __name__ == "__main__":

    uc = UseCase(name="pue", date_start="2024-01-01", date_end="2025-04-25")
